title: Grateful Dead Live at Stanley Theatre on 1972-09-28
lineage: ?>7" reel @ 3.75 ips, dolby b technics rs-1506>teac an-180>hd-p2 24/96>hd>cd wave>adobe 2.0 16/44>flac

ai_review.summary: Great show with a smoking St. Stephen jam, but the audience‑recorded clapping makes the audio largely unlistenable.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the performance – especially the extended St. Stephen jam – and agree the concert was a standout night. Unfortunately the recording is an audience capture overwhelmed by nonstop stadium applause, rendering much of the music hard to hear and often unlistenable.

ai_rating.rationale: The show itself is consistently praised as excellent, but all reviewers note severe recording problems (excessive clapping, muffled mix) that greatly diminish listenability, pulling the overall rating down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is decent in places but constantly buried under thunderous stadium clapping; many sections become unlistenable due to the crowd noise overwhelming the band.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall high‑energy performance with strong jams, though the recording masks much of the flow.
